name: Madrigal de las Altas Torres
summary: A Castilian town remembered as the birthplace of Isabella I of Castile.
overview: Madrigal de las Altas Torres was a Castilian town with royal associations.
It is remembered especially for Isabella I, whose reign helped reshape late medieval Iberia.
